description: UNDERSTANDING — what a whole market gets WRONG: the agent-readiness checks its members most commonly fail, ranked by what fixing each would move the cohort mean. The inverse of gap_analysis, which says where a market is under-served; this says where it is failing the rubric. Turns "fix your OpenAPI" into "this industry does not publish OpenAPI", which is the shape of a finding worth publishing. Named checks only — facet rollups cannot name the checks underneath them. Priced per result — $0.005 per request plus $0.0002 per record returned (less past 100), capped at $0.50 a request, under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. Estimate first at /api/v1/prices/estimate. See apis://prices.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.
